in_marathi.name: Dheeti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheeti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheeti is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dhee' which means 'intelligence' or 'wisdom'. The name is also associated with the goddess Dhiti, who is considered the embodiment of divine wisdom and power. In Hindu mythology, Dhiti is the mother of the god Indra, the king of the gods.
